schemes.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Central Sector Scheme for College Students
schemes.description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher education.
schemes.benefits: ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years and ₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level.

schemes.title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC / ST / OBC / EWS Students
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial support to SC/ST/OBC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stages.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefits: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees coverage plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month.
schemes.applicationMethod: Online via NSP or State Scholarship Portals

schemes.title: Uttar Pradesh Free Laptop & Tablet Distribution Scheme (Swami Vivekanand Yuva Empowerment)
schemes.description: State government initiative distributing free smartphones and tablets to final-year undergraduate and diploma students in UP.
schemes.ministry: Department of IT and Electronics, UP
schemes.benefits: Free branded Tablet or Smartphone for digital learning and e-exam access.
schemes.applicationMethod: Automatic nomination through college DigiShakti portal portal

schemes.title: Free Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.description: Financial award of ₹25,000 for purchasing laptops awarded to MP Board Class 12 students scoring above 75% marks.
schemes.benefits: ₹25,000 direct bank transfer to purchase a personal laptop for higher studies.
schemes.applicationMethod: Direct DBT via Shiksha Portal MP

schemes.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme for Meritorious Girls (Pragati & Saksham)
schemes.description: Special AICTE scholarship empowering meritorious female students and differently-abled students pursuing degree or diploma technical education.
schemes.benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for college fees, laptop purchase, books, and educational software.
schemes.applicationMethod: Online application via National Scholarship Portal

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Direct income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000 per year transferred directly in 3 installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.
schemes.applicationMethod: Online via PM-KISAN Portal or local CSC Centers

schemes.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.description: Comprehensive credit support scheme for farmers providing timely access to short-term loans for agriculture and allied activities at subsidized interest rates.
schemes.benefits: Revolving credit line up to ₹3 Lakh at 4% effective interest rate with prompt repayment incentive.
schemes.applicationMethod: Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks, or PM-KISAN portal linkage

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Comprehensive crop insurance cover against crop loss due to non-preventable natural risks, drought, floods, pests, and severe weather.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Full crop sum insured claim payout with low farmer premium (1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif crops).
schemes.applicationMethod: Online via PMFBY portal, Banks, or CSC Centres

schemes.title: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
schemes.description: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefits: Direct online transparent bidding, higher crop price realization, and online payment directly to bank accounts.
schemes.applicationMethod: Online via e-NAM portal or Mandi Helpdesk

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.description: The world's largest health assurance scheme providing ₹5 Lakh health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
schemes.ministry: National Health Authority & Ministry of Health
schemes.benefits: Cashless and paperless medical treatment up to ₹5,000,000 per family per year in over 27,000 empanelled hospitals.
schemes.applicationMethod: Empanelled Hospital Ayushman Mitra Desk or PMJAY Portal

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
schemes.description: Government scheme providing quality generic medicines at 50% to 90% lower prices compared to branded medicines through dedicated Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
schemes.ministry: Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers
schemes.benefits: Access to over 1,800 generic medicines and 290 surgical items at ultra-affordable subsidized rates.
schemes.applicationMethod: Walk-in to any PMBJP Jan Aushadhi Kendra across India

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: Accidental insurance scheme offering financial coverage against accidental death or permanent full/partial disability.
schemes.benefits: ₹2 Lakh coverage for accidental death or total permanent disability; ₹1 Lakh for partial disability at an annual premium of just ₹20.
requiredDocuments: Savings Bank Account with Auto-Debit facility
schemes.applicationMethod: Online netbanking or physical form submission at participating bank branch

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: One-year life insurance scheme renewable annually offering life cover for death due to any reason.
schemes.benefits: ₹2 Lakh life coverage payable to nominee upon death of insured due to any reason for ₹436 annual premium.
schemes.applicationMethod: Bank Netbanking / Bank Branch Auto-Debit Consent

schemes.title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: Guaranteed social security pension scheme primarily targeted at unorganized sector workers.
schemes.benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60.
schemes.applicationMethod: Bank Branch / APY Online Portal via Bank Account

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY / Poshan 2.0)
schemes.description: Maternity benefit program providing cash incentives to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health and nutrition support.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.benefits: Direct cash assistance of ₹5,000 in installments upon fulfilling antenatal & child immunization milestones.
schemes.applicationMethod: Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or PMMVY Online Portal

schemes.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.description: Small deposit savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children providing high government-backed interest rate and tax tax exemption under 80C.
schemes.benefits: High compounding interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.) with tax-free returns for higher education/marriage of girl child.
schemes.applicationMethod: Post Office or Authorized Commercial Banks

schemes.title: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0 - Skill India)
schemes.description: Flagship skill certification scheme enabling Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training for better livelihoods.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.benefits: Free certified technical skill training, assessment allowance, placement assistance, and NCVT Certificate.

schemes.title: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
schemes.description: Government bridge program for diploma holders and engineering graduates providing practical industry apprenticeship training.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Education & Board of Practical Training
schemes.benefits: Monthly stipend up to ₹9,000/month co-funded by Government of India with 1-year hands-on industry training.

### 🛂 Indian Passport Application Guide (English)

Here is the official process to apply for a fresh Indian Passport:

* **Eligibility**: Citizen of India, age 18+ (adult) or minor.
* **Required Documents**:
  1. **Address Proof**: Water/Electricity bill, Bank passbook, Aadhaar card, or Rent Agreement.
  2. **Date of Birth Proof**: Birth Certificate, Matriculation transfer certificate, or PAN Card.
  3. **Non-ECR Category Proof**: 10th Standard passing certificate.
* **Fees**: ₹1,500 for normal application (36 pages); ₹3,500 for Tatkaal scheme.
* **Processing Time**: 15–30 days for Normal; 1–3 days for Tatkaal.
* **Official Process**:
  1. Register on the official Passport Seva portal (*passportindia.gov.in*).
  2. Fill the online form and pay the fee online.
  3. Book an appointment at your nearest PSK (Passport Seva Kendra) or Post Office PSK.
  4. Attend the appointment for biometric scanning and document verification.
  5. Police verification will be conducted at your registered address.
  6. The passport is delivered via Speed Post.
* **Tips**: Make sure the spellings on your Aadhaar and 10th certificate match exactly to avoid verification delays.
